name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes role (advance per-tile event-tile animation state for consumed event tiles). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Advance the per-tile animation frame counter for every consumed event tile so a just-consumed tile (opened chest / picked-up item / triggered event) redraws in its open/empty sprite frame.
logic_summary: Double loop over the whole battle map grid (row 0..data_fd2_battle_map_height_tiles-1, col 0..data_fd2_battle_map_width_tiles-1). For each tile, fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos(col,row,&buf) fills buf (+0 2B tile_meta_low, +2 2B tile_idx_combined/terrain_class, +4 1B tile_attr_flags). Gate: (tile_attr_flags & 0x60)==0x20 (event tile) AND tile_event_consumed_flags[tile_idx_combined]!=0 (already consumed). For a match, compute tile metadata addr = data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr + (width*row+col)*4, then *(short*)(addr+4) += 1 (bump frame counter) and *(byte*)(addr+6) = 0 (reset phase flag). The +4/+6 writes intentionally land in the next tile's 4-byte record (vendor stride design; see fd2_obfuscate_battle_tile_map for map layout).

returns.semantics: No return value; mutates the tile-map animation state buffer in place.

comment_original_issue: Src comment claimed 'Called once per frame from main composite.' which is factually wrong: all 6 callers (fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction field pickup, fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher case 5, fd2_chapter_event_handler_37/3a/3d scripted pickups, fd2_load_save_and_init_engine init) invoke it right after marking an event tile consumed -- it is event-triggered, not per-frame.
notes: writes_globals lists data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr because the function writes through that pointer into the tile-map record buffer (+4 word, +6 byte); it does not reassign the pointer itself. The +4/+6 offsets fall in the adjacent tile record on purpose (intended vendor stride, consistent with project_vendor_overflow_arrays). Ghidra plate already matched refined understanding -> left untouched. Global names verified against src/include/globals.h.
